messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER alert: tenant=horizon-bank-prod on dedicated pool redwood-dedicated-pool-3 (VPC). Sudden spike in 502/504s observed from requests arriving through customer gateway hb-gateway-eu. Error rate ~22% over 10m. Likely gateway/proxy timeout interactions. Paging leah (primary on-call).

leah: acknowledged, joining. Looking at edge traces now. Errors started ~15:20 UTC. Stack shows `upstream prematurely closed connection` and `read timeout` on streaming endpoints. No model errors or infra OOMs.

tom (eng-runtime): telemetry: ingress qps steady but active connections increased sharply; p95 latency for stream endpoints jumped to ~2.6s. Backend model latencies unchanged. Looks like customer gateway is resetting connections when idle.

priya (eng-sre): @emily can you confirm if account saw any config changes on their gateway? Also looping in support to notify customer.

emily (acct): spoke to Horizon infra lead. They deployed a gateway policy change at ~15:15 to reduce idle timeout and to aggressively retry on 502s. They rolled back but some clients still reconnecting quickly.

danny (solutions): this smells like retry amplification. If their gateway retries on 502/504 with low backoff, we get a surge of new connections and dropped long-lived streams. Mitigations we can try:
- Short term: add per-tenant early-ack on stream endpoints so the gateway sees activity (minimize idle perception).
- Short term: increase our upstream keepalive timeout and allow longer request timeouts for horizon-bank routes.
- Protective: add per-tenant connection caps and token bucket throttling at edge.

leah: implementing early-ack toggle for `/v1/stream` now and bumping route timeout 30s -> 90s for horizon-bank. Patch:
```
# route override horizon-bank
routing/tenants/horizon-bank-prod:
  upstream_timeout: "90s"
  stream_early_ack: true
```

IncidentBot: Deploy job started for route override by leah. CI checks passing.

tom: also applying a soft circuit-breaker for their tenant to avoid noisy neighbor: max_conns=80, max_pending=150, drop_policy=reject.

priya: I'm enabling token-bucket per-tenant: refill_rate=50/s, capacity=200 for horizon-bank while we stabilize.

leah: changes deployed. Immediate telemetry: 5xxs dropped from 22% -> 9% in first 4m. Long-lived websocket handshakes showing fewer resets. Still seeing sporadic spikes tied to specific TRACEs: hz-tr-212, hz-tr-219.

emily: Horizon ops say user-facing errors reduced but payments flow still sees occasional timeouts. They've left gateway retries at a lower rate for now.

danny: additional short-term tweak: enable chunked keepalive pings on stream frames so customer's gateway doesn't treat idle streams as dead.

leah: applying chunked keepalive: `stream_keepalive_interval: 10s` for horizon-bank routes. Also adding an ingress queue limit to avoid backpressure to other tenants.

IncidentBot: Config changes applied: early-ack, extended timeout, stream_keepalive_interval, circuit-breaker, token-bucket. Monitoring.

tom: current metrics: error rate down to ~5.6%, websocket success up ~55% over baseline. Pending queue stable. No other tenants impacted.

priya: creating incident ticket INC-2026-0550-horizon for follow-up and postmortem. Preserving edge logs and traces: hz-tr-212, hz-tr-219, hz-tr-223. Recommend capture of gateway access logs from customer's side.

emily: sending a short customer note: apology + summary of our mitigations and ask if they'd like us to keep overrides or revert after a confirmed window. Copy to horizon-support@horizon-bank.com.

leah: handoff note for night: I'll hand this to morning crew at 08:00 UTC. Runbook for handoff:
- watch `tenant.errors(horizon-bank-prod)` and `edge.stream_keepalive` tile
- rollback path: remove overrides and re-evaluate if customer gateway stabilize
- escalation: if error rate >15% sustained for 10m or p95 >3s escalate to eng-runtime
- preserve traces and images for 48h

danny: postmortem action items:
- add docs to Dedicated onboarding with recommended gateway settings (idle timeouts, retry backoffs, max concurrent connections)
- implement automatic detection for retry amplification patterns per-tenant and an automated soft-throttle
- add a canary for route-timeout changes

priya: I'll file PR for a telemetry flag `client_retry_spike` and a dashboard alert threshold.

emily: confirmed customer update sent. Horizon ops will monitor and schedule a joint conference tomorrow AM to align gateway defaults.

IncidentBot: Incident moved to follow-up. Pager cleared for leah. Please link postmortem to INC-2026-0550-horizon.

Participants: IncidentBot, leah, tom, priya, danny, emily
